description: Photovoltaic data is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Quynh-Anh Nguyen. The dataset, obtained from the 1.8 MW Yulara Solar System at the DKASolar Centre near Uluru, Australia, includes one year of 5-minute interval data (Dec 1, 2022 – Nov 30, 2023). It consists of 104,879 entries out of an expected 105,120 due to missing values. Coverage: national (AU); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
